description: The signed-in traveller's travel preferences, as set in the Meridian Dispatch app (How you like to travel): how much they like each kind of travel (coast, old towns, ancient sites, nature, scenic drives, big cities, hiking, museums, food, nightlife, snow, wellness: love, like, sometimes or not for me), the stays they like, their pace (one base, a few bases, always moving), whether they want new places or old favourites, and the countries they have been to (ISO codes). Use it to suggest destinations and places that fit, and to tell new countries from ones they know. Needs sign-in.
name: get_travel_preferences
title: Get my travel preferences
